id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

nonMetricField.description: `nonMetricField`: A simple `double` field for storing non-metric data without any caching.

metricField.description: `metricField`: A metric field cached using the expression 'identity(1)' and updated daily ('DAY').

metricField2.description:
`metricField2`: A metric field cached using the expression 'identity(2)' and updated daily ('DAY').
It includes additional configurations like a cron expression to trigger evaluation at noon on January 1st
of every year, a filter condition to evaluate the field only when `nonMetricField > 10`, and is enabled
for evaluation (`disabled=false`).

title:
Entity type `FieldStoredMetricCacheListenerTestCreated` represents a schema named 'FSMC_TST_CRTD'.
This schema includes both metric and non-metric fields. Metric fields are cached and evaluated based on
specified expressions, intervals, and optional conditions. This entity also mixes in the `FeatureEvaluatable`
schema to support feature evaluation.
name: FieldStoredMetricCacheListenerTestCreated
